newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm on strong demand.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly tea auction in Mombasa on Monday, boosted by strong demand, auction officials said.

Brighter BP1s were 2-8 U.S. cents dearer while other brighter grades rose by up to 10 cents. Selected PDusts gained by up to 30 cents. Brightest Dust1s gained up to 15 cents while brighter mediums appreciated by 8-21 cents.

In the secondary catalogues, all prices were dearer. Bright Fannings were a particularly strong feature. Pakistan and Egypt were strong. Sudan, Britain and South Africa showed interest. --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261.
